question: Which mantra effected the release of the lord of gods from Rāvaṇa's prison?
premises: The lord of gods was imprisoned by Rāvaṇa
He was released from that prison
Release occurred by means of this mantra
inference: By this mantra the lord of gods was freed from Rāvaṇa's prison
plain_english: By this mantra the lord of the gods was released from Rāvaṇa's prison.
